description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based medical exam questions with comprehensive instructions, explanations, and references for exam preparation.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based MCQs based on difficulty, context, and image context, including instructions for explanations and references.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and scenario realism, with scoring and issue identification.
